decisions.reason: With quantified results from government use and connections to over 30 APIS schemes, the product clearly exceeds aspiration levels and fits the firm's core aviation security business.

Demand for travel health requirements has fallen sharply since the pandemic, so results likely fall short of aspiration, but its own web page and the expanding firm's slack let it be carried a while longer.
A low-cost training module close to the established certified-trainer offer, with growing cyber awareness demand, needs little search and is easily carried by slack despite no reported results.
Behaviour analysis builds on the firm's specialist detection expertise and supports its innovation strategy for airports, so the uncertain results are tolerated given the firm's expansion and slack.
Passenger profiling is a core differentiating method for aviation clients; although it is only mentioned and has no evidence of results, it is cheap to keep within the integrated offer.
Document verification sits close to the established offer and complements the passenger data solution, and its own web page signals commitment while results are still pending.
